dropped.title: Cl0p PTC Windchill/FlexPLM — GE joins Philips and Shell as investigating
dropped.reason: GE's statement is an acknowledgement that it is assessing a claim, not a confirmation of compromise. The campaign already carries a 2026-08-15 victim-confirmation entry and a 2026-08-16 weekly status. A third name saying 'we are aware' is victim-count bookkeeping, not the material development PD-8's update rule requires; the vulnerability, exploitation mechanism and remediation guidance are unchanged. S4 itself proposed folding rather than a standalone entry.

dropped.title: 'TheHatman' claims 3.64M Azure/Entra directory records from nine enterprises incl. Vodafone
dropped.reason: Fails the PD-11 breach gate. Out-of-nexus victim set (one European telco named, unconfirmed); no named victim confirms an intrusion and TCS actively disputes the framing; the assessed mechanism (infostealer-harvested credentials reaching a cloud tenant) is neither new nor materially evolved, so limb (b) fails, and limbs (a), (c) and (d) are unmet — no actor read onto European CI/government, no shared imminent exposure. The only defender takeaway available is generic identity hygiene, which is exactly what actions[] and the inclusion gate exclude.

dropped.title: Unisoc VoLTE video-call chain to Android kernel memory (SSD Secure Disclosure)
dropped.reason: Technically substantive (baseband-to-application-processor MPU isolation bypass) but two failures: the primary advisory could not be read on any transport this run (JS-only SPA; reader pool exhausted), leaving two news relays of a single source; and the affected handsets are budget/mid-range models with no established presence in this constituency's fleets, with exploitation gated on a rogue 4G network plus an answered video call. Relevance doubt resolves toward drop. Queued to state/coverage_backlog.md for re-attempt once reader credit is restored.

dropped.title: DGFiP — interministerial crisis cell, ANSSI audit tasking, actor claims data already sold
dropped.reason: Governance and press-cycle movement on an incident already published 2026-08-15: a crisis cell, an audit tasking with conclusions due in September, and notification logistics. No new technical fact, no new access vector, no exploitation-status change — nothing a Tier 2/3 responder acts on in the next seven days. The 'already sold' line is the actor's own unverifiable claim, explicitly labelled as such by the outlet carrying it. Note: S4 independently reached the same drop; S2 proposed keeping it.
